name: Guild Mage
subjectPrompt: An adult human male guild wizard from Hillsfar with a lean face, trimmed dark beard and practical dusty plum and charcoal traveling robes. Leather belt and a small sheathed dagger. He looks alert and cautious, accustomed to traveling with a merchant caravan. Full figure, in profile turned three quarters toward the viewer. Quiet human proportions, grounded cloth, no spellbook, no staff. Use reference two only for a general sense of layered wizard's robes and hand-cast magic. Keep his identity and clothing freshly designed.
